about.title: Raised on organic pastures in the heart of Transylvania.
about.p1: Belmont Group raises pure-bred Angus cattle on certified organic pastures in the Transylvanian villages of Glâmboaca, Colun, and Săsăuș in Romania. We operate both owned and leased land, growing our own feed crops to support our herd year-round.
about.p2: As a suckler cow operation, we produce beef cattle through natural pasture farming — entirely free from hormones and artificial additives. Our team works alongside nature, allowing our cattle to grow in a calm, stress-free environment that mirrors the natural rhythms of the land.
about.p3: The Belmont Group is wholly owned by a Swiss family.

angus.title: Angus: hardy, calm, efficient — and naturally built for premium beef.
angus.intro: The Angus breed originates from Scotland and is prized for exceptional meat quality, ease of management, hardiness, fertility, and natural adaptability.

philosophy.quote: “What our cattle eat determines their health. Their health determines the quality of the meat.”
philosophy.title: Going back to what is real.
philosophy.p1: At Belmont Group, we believe in extensive, low-intensity farming. In summer, our cattle graze exclusively on fresh grass. In winter, they are fed hay and silage grown entirely on our own land.
philosophy.p2: Cattle that live outdoors, move freely, and feed on natural pasture produce beef that is honest: nutrient-rich, easy to digest, and truly natural in the best sense of the word.
philosophy.p3: Belmont Group is committed to responsible, measured, and high-quality land management with a focus on food production.

romania.title: A dynamic country with deep agricultural roots.
romania.p1: Romania is a dynamic country in Eastern Europe with a rich history, a growing economy, and deep roots in agriculture. Since joining the European Union in 2007, Romania has made significant strides in infrastructure, investment, and regional influence.
romania.p2: The country has fertile soils and is a major agricultural producer. Livestock farming is widespread and deeply embedded in rural culture.
romania.imageAlt: View over a river valley with mountains in the distance

transylvania.title: Clean air, traditional landscapes, natural farming.
transylvania.p1: Transylvania is one of Romania's most celebrated regions — surrounded by the Carpathian Mountains and known for medieval heritage, multicultural history, and breathtaking natural landscapes.
transylvania.p2: For Belmont Group, Transylvania represents more than a location. Its clean air, traditional agricultural landscape, and low-intensity land use provide ideal conditions for extensive cattle farming.
transylvania.imageAlt: Herd resting on pasture with snow-capped mountains behind
